== Ingredients ==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] cooked sticky [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]], beaten
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Granulated Sugar|granulated sugar]]
* [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|All-purpose flour]]
* 2½ [[Cookbook:Quart|quarts]] [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|vegetable oil]]
* [[Cookbook:Powdered Sugar|Powdered sugar]] (optional)

== Procedure ==
#Combine rice, eggs, and sugar. Form into 3-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] balls. [[Cookbook:Dredging|Dredge]] in flour and set aside 2–3 minutes.
#Heat oil to 375°F. Add rice balls and, working in batches, fry until golden brown and heated through.
#Drain fritters on a [[Cookbook:Cooling Rack|cooling rack]] set in a sheet pan.
#If desired, [[Cookbook:Dusting|dust]] with powdered sugar before serving.
